task_spec: Add order_total(items, coupon_bps): our billing rule applies the coupon to the PRE-TAX subtotal (discount first), THEN adds 8% tax on the discounted amount. The order matters because tax is owed on what the customer actually pays.

bugs.description: order_total taxes the full subtotal first and applies the coupon afterward, but the spec requires discount-BEFORE-tax (coupon on the pre-tax subtotal, then tax the discounted amount). The two orders give different totals; tax-first over-charges tax. Both orderings are locally plausible; only the billing rule in the spec picks one.

provenance.note: arbitrary order-of-operations rule; only in spec
